scripts.build:wasm: cd pdf-wasm && cargo clean && rm -rf pkg && wasm-pack build --target web --release --out-dir ./pkg && cp pkg/pdf_wasm.js ../public/wasm/pdf_wasm.js && cp pkg/pdf_wasm_bg.wasm ../public/wasm/pdf_wasm_bg.wasm && cp pkg/pdf_wasm.js ../public/wasm/pdfium_wasm.js && cp pkg/pdf_wasm_bg.wasm ../public/wasm/pdfium_wasm_bg.wasm
scripts.build-w:wasm: cd pdf-wasm && cargo clean && if exist pkg rmdir /s /q pkg && wasm-pack build --target web --release --out-dir ./pkg && copy pkg\pdf_wasm.js ..\public\wasm\pdf_wasm.js && copy pkg\pdf_wasm_bg.wasm ..\public\wasm\pdf_wasm_bg.wasm && copy pkg\pdf_wasm.js ..\public\wasm\pdfium_wasm.js && copy pkg\pdf_wasm_bg.wasm ..\public\wasm\pdfium_wasm_bg.wasm
scripts.build-wasm-excel: cd excel-wasm && cargo clean && if exist pkg rmdir /s /q pkg && wasm-pack build --target web --release --out-dir ./pkg && xcopy pkg\excel_wasm.js ..\public\wasm\ /Y && xcopy pkg\excel_wasm_bg.wasm ..\public\wasm\ /Y && xcopy pkg\excel_wasm.d.ts ..\public\wasm\ /Y
